summary: S3StorageBackend — backend for all S3-family providers (AWS S3, S3 Express, R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2). Composed of 8 operation modules: s3_connection.py (boto3 client init via adapter), s3_read.py (streaming GET), s3_write.py (put_object + multipart), s3_list.py (list_objects_v2), s3_delete.py (delete_object), s3_copy.py (server-side copy_object), s3_metadata.py (head_object), s3_path.py (bucket/key extraction). Registered for multiple CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE values via S3Settings FLAVOR dispatch. Supports configurable connect_timeout and read_timeout.
lifecycle_notes: S3 Express requires different session token handling — the adapter handles this
Configurable connect_timeout/read_timeout added in 2026-05-07 HTTP+S3 timeouts plan
risks: Server-side copy_object has a 5GB limit for non-multipart — large file copies require multipart copy
Pagination in list_objects_v2 must handle continuation tokens for buckets with >1000 objects
